digest.component_or_area: Jira family reconciler, rich-text codec and sync layer
propositions: Cloud ADF encode path converts Markdown descriptions and comments to structured ADF paragraphs without plain-text fallback
DC wiki render path converts safe Markdown descriptions and comments to native Jira wiki markup via pandoc with configurable timeout and fallback for missing/failed pandoc
Echo-safety mechanism using per-binding baselines and change-gated rich_sha prevents redundant outbound updates when local and remote bodies are identical after normalization
Three-way baseline/local/remote comparison with last-write-wins resolves concurrent edits and flags conflicts instead of silent overwrites
Origin-gated outbound preservation ensures Jira-native constructs (panels, mentions, dates) survive reconciliation cycles without erosion
Append-only comment ID map persists local-to-Jira comment mappings with codec-routed creation; comment bodies use identical rich-text codec as descriptions
